id.description: Ruling id, unique within the council run. Engine-assigned on append.

topic.description: The contested topic id this ruling resolves. Deterministic link for the consensus engine (ruled topics freeze).

point_of_contention.description: The specific contested point, restated as a question or proposition.

ruling.description: The decision on that point, stated as a directive the council must work within.

reasoning.description: Why, grounded in the arguments as presented (never in sources the judge cannot see).

conditions.description: Conditions attached to the ruling, if any.

binding.description: Rulings are immutable facts (design law 3). The engine rejects non-binding rulings.
